report.root_cause: TownCore config.yml (plugins/TownCore/config.yml) had shop.tax-rate set to the string "5%". Validation requires a number between 0 and 1, so the plugin disabled itself about 28s after startup.
report.actions: Saw TownCore DISABLED in status and declared an incident. Found the IllegalArgumentException in the logs and read the config. Changed tax-rate to 0.05. Tried "plugman reload TownCore", which doesn't exist. The plugin stayed disabled, so I restarted the server. TownCore came back enabled, and it stayed enabled with no new errors for more than 60s after restart.
report.residual_risk: I assumed "5%" meant 0.05, so the tax rate should be confirmed with the owner. The restart briefly disconnected the two online players. Nothing validates the config before it's edited, so another bad value would disable the plugin again.
